title: Survival Expanded
description: This mod adds lots of new vanilla-style features. Made using MCreator
body:
# Survival Expanded

## Description
Survival Expanded is a vanilla-style mod which adds many new features, including:

- 5 new structures
- 1 new boss
- 3 new weapon types
- 3 new enchantments
- 2 new potions
- 7 more new potions for vanilla effects
- 1 new command
- 1 new mineral
- A weapon upgrade system

Here I will try to explain some of these features.

## Structures

###  Trading Post
Trading posts are wooden towers which are found in plains and other similar biomes. They have villagers living in them and have 2 chests in the top, containing mostly emeralds and enchanted leather armor.

###  Captured Trading Post
Captured trading posts are trading posts which have been captured by illagers. They are very dangerous, but have better loot than normal trading posts.

###  Ruins
Ruins are the remains of ancient structures. They are rare and are found in most biomes. They have 2 chests with low-quality loot.


![Ruins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91212c96c5d447276c66f5d8b4ed95d532da4699.webp)


###  Desert Dungeon
Desert dungeons are massive structures which spawn deep under desert biomes. They have a huge amount of loot, but they have many monster spawners and a new kind of skeleton.


![Desert Dungeon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/051305d1623e695acba196f798b28d8b6ac43b49.png)


###  Evoker Tower
Evoker towers are stone towers which appear in plains and other similar biomes. They have high-quality enchanted loot and a new boss, the Archevoker, spawns in the top of the tower.


## Weapons


![Weapons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9176ec5a8a580b42bfcd0f7e36aa7278d7fe9076.webp)


### Daggers
Daggers are very cheap to craft. They deal low damage but have a very fast attack speed. They also have a new enchantment, Bloodthirsting, which gives them a lifesteal ability.

### Greataxes
Greataxes are expensive to craft, have extremely high damage, and a slow attack speed.

### Warhammers
Warhammers are the most expensive weapon type to craft. They have a slow attack speed and lower damage than greataxes, but they can hit multiple mobs with a critical strike.
They have a special enchantment called Bludgeoning which boosts the damage of the critical strike attack.

## Potions


![Potions and Other Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d6c451d301c3f8b35e7513a11f4108cff60b7962.webp)


### Potion of Health Boost
Potions of Health Boost are brewed with a potion of healing and an emerald.

### Potion of Resistance
Potions of Resistance are brewed with an awkward potion and an iron block.

### Potion of Decay
Potions of Decay are brewed with an awkward potion and a wither rose.

### Potion of Haste
Potions of Haste are brewed with a potion of swiftness and a gold ingot.

### Potion of Mining Fatigue
Potions of Mining Fatigue are brewed with a potion of haste and a fermented spider eye.

### Potion of Luck
Potions of luck are brewed with a thick potion and a rabbit's foot.

### Potion of Bad Luck
Potions of bad luck are brewed with a potion of luck and a fermented spider eye.

### Potion of Blindness
Potions of Blindness are brewed with a potion of night vision and blaze powder.

### Potion of Health Curse
Potions of health curse are brewed with a potion of health boost and a fermented spider eye. The health curse debuff reduces a target's max health.

### Potion of Power
Potions of Power are brewed with an awkward potion and an enchanted golden apple. They grant almost every beneficial status effect.

## Weapon Upgrade System


![Glow Shards](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e156e4c3fd5afcd8ea2e64a6a26ae355c2258e9.png)


There are new minerals called glow shards which appear inside geodes underground. Glow shards can be crafted with swords to inflict potion effects on a hit.

### Level 1
Level 1 upgrades are crafted with 1 glow shard.
Possible Potion Effects:
- Poison I
- Wither I
- Slowness I

### Level 2
Level 2 upgrades are crafted with 4 glow shards.
Possible Potion Effects:
- Poison II
- Wither II
- Weakness I

### Level 3
Level 3 upgrades are crafted with 8 glow shards.
Possible Potion Effects:
- Poison III
- Wither III
- Slowness III

## Planned Updates
- Glow shard recipes for all weapon types
- More enchantments, including one for greataxes

## Other Information
When using commands to access content from the mod, use the namespace "magickmod".
